name: Tinanchai Bunnark
original_name: ティナンチャイ ブンナーク
source:
A cabaret club hostess who has come from Thailand to work abroad and earn money.

Her cute appearance and charmingly broken Japanese have made her popular with customers at the club.

She is commonly known by the nickname "Tina."

She takes a liking to the protagonist because he reminds her of her older brother Piichaai back home. Whenever he visits the club, she welcomes him with a radiant smile.

She is a hardworking and devoted young woman who has come to Japan to support her family financially.

Although she works in the nightlife industry, she has no previous sexual experience.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11700]the official site[/url]]
